description: This file contains shell functions and configurations related to platform-specific upgrade procedures for different device boards. It includes functions for upgrading to SD boot, copying configuration, checking images, and performing upgrades based on board types, mostly for embedded Linux devices.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_sdboot
methods.description: Upgrades device via SD card by extracting kernel and root filesystem, and writing them to specific device partitions.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_traverse_slotubi
methods.description: Handles firmware upgrade procedure for devices using UBI overlay, based on current boot slot.

methods.name: platform_copy_config_sdboot
methods.description: Copies configuration backup to device’s SD card partition.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Replicates device-specific configuration copying depending on board type.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Validates the upgrade image for supported board types.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade dispatcher that determines the upgrade method based on the device's board type.
